module: First-person camera of the on-foot character ("unicycle": the player vehicle on foot). Hidden. Head rotation comes from the yaw/pitch inputs (pitch limited to ±89.9 degrees), zoom from data.unicycleZoom (FOV from 55 to 27). The position follows the vehicle's head node (core_camera.getDriverData). Sends the camera rotation to the vehicle controller (playerController.setCameraControlData). Supports OpenXR snap turn. setCustomData sets the position (placed on the ground at 1.6 m from the eyes) and the starting direction. Returns a constructor.
notes: Constants: human height 1.6 m, hip 0.45 * height, crouching 0.7; max fall 10 m, gravity -2 m/s2 in attemptToWalk, which is local to the file and never called in this file (unused code).
getEyePosition uses the variable `crouching` which does not exist in scope (nil): crouching is therefore never taken into account.
onCameraChanged does nothing if the player vehicle is itself a unicycle; otherwise loads the "unicycle" apps layout on focus gain and asks again for the game state on loss.
getRotVecFromFrontUp forces a horizontal pitch (rotVec.y = 180): the code comment says "the math below is broken".

C.desc: Pedestrian camera mode. Fields: pos (vec3), rotVec (vec3 degrees, y = 180 to look horizontally).

init.desc: Prepares the zoom smoothing and reads the settings.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: re-reads the OpenXR snap turn settings.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: loads or leaves the "unicycle" interface layout (see notes).

focused.desc: true if the mode takes focus

reset.desc: Resets the zoom smoothing to zero.

setCustomData.desc: Sets the initial position and/or orientation; called by setGlobalCameraByName.

customData.desc: pos (vec3, brought to eye level), front and up (vec3, starting direction)

getPosRot.desc: Current position and rotation of the camera.

update.desc: Applies rotation, zoom and position, and sends the rotation to the player's controller.
